title: IM ABOUT TO PUT YOU TF ON.
label: Draft synopsis · Ryan Homanics · shared October 22, 2026
paragraphs: IM ABOUT TO PUT YOU TF ON.
Ever seen what addiction actually looks like?
I mean ACTUALLY looks like.

Not the version you’ve assumed in your head.
Not the version corporate media cleaned up and packaged for you.
The version that is a fish scale kind of raw
that will shake your mind worse than my hands trying to load a cranker
on the 4th day without sleep and a 140 resting heartrate.

6 straight years, 5 total chemical addictions, $400 a day average, 3 different suicide notes, 2 obliterating traumas, and 1 shattered brain I thought would never see reclaim its prior razor sharpness.
Discover how its possible for a person to be
Full time roofer. Full time Security and Intelligence Masters student.

HoneyBee keeper of 5 hives.
 All while smoking crack every single day and dragging along an opiate tolerance
that would overdose a track horse.
Years without pause, slowdown, or interruption.
And the only soul in the universe that knew about the walk of this tight rope,
Died halfway through it.
Losing reality. Losing people. Losing control.
But this isn’t just about drugs, or even about me at all.
Its about YOU.
The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to ignore:

The same behavior that destroys one life
is the same behavior shaping the entire system around YOU.
Molding and designing the very way you are able to perceive the very nature of
Reality itself.

Same brain jarring cravings.
Same self serving rationalizations.
Same spiraling inability to stop.
Down to the same neurological pathways themselves.
The only difference is scale.
Your entire existence is planned by, built by, led by, steered by, determined by,
CRACKHEADS.
This book doesn’t explain addiction.
It shows you what it feels like.

And once you feel it…
you’ll start seeing it everywhere.
And once you understand it…
you’ll never be able to pretend that you’re asleep as you are stepped over
ever again.

So follow me and lets go down this dark alley, its going to blow your fucking mind how much shit you are about to learn from someone as you watch them smack down a nuke and turn on the freebase fog machine.
Good luck…..this about to be a whole thing for you.
